 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):

   self.k.qpos[self.s._jq[:7]]=q;mj.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k);mj.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
   e=np.r_[p-self.k.xpos[self.b],Rotation.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e[:3])<.0001 and np.linalg.norm(e[3:])<.001:break
   mj.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jacp,self.jacr,self.b)
   J=np.r_[self.jacp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],self.jacr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]]

   t=(i+1)/n;t=t*t*(3-2*t)
   self.step(p0+(p-p0)*t,Rotation.from_rotvec(rv*t).as_matrix()@R0,h0+(h-h0)*t)
 def hold(self,h,n=100):

    vertices = []
